payout_quote: Referring cardholders can earn $100 in bonus cash rewards or 10,000 points per friend and family member account opened (up to $500 or 50,000 points per year).
steps: Hold an eligible Bank of America credit card (Customized Cash Rewards, Unlimited Cash Rewards, or Travel Rewards at launch; more cards being added through 2026)
Access your personalized referral link in the Bank of America mobile app or online banking
Share the link with friends and family via text, email, or social media
When a friend applies and is approved for the card, you earn $100 in bonus cash rewards or 10,000 points per account opened
catches: Cap: up to $500 in bonus cash rewards or 50,000 points per year
Eligibility at launch: Customized Cash Rewards, Unlimited Cash Rewards, or Travel Rewards cardholders; program expanding to more cards through 2026
Friend must apply and be approved for the card; friend receives the current new-account offer
Full program terms are shown in-app; the bank's announcement is via its official newsroom/press release
10,000 points valued at face value ($100) per the bank's own framing ($100 cash or 10,000 points)
biggest_catch: $100 (or 10,000 points) per approved card — but you must already hold an eligible BofA card, and your friend has to be approved for a new credit card.
eligibility: Bank of America cardholders with eligible cards (Customized Cash Rewards, Unlimited Cash Rewards, Travel Rewards at launch)
timing: Earned when the referred friend applies and is approved
